newsitem.title: USA: K-III execs buy 80,000 K-III common shares.
newsitem.headline: K-III execs buy 80,000 K-III common shares.

text.p: K-III Communications Corp said on Monday that its chairman and chief executive officer, William Reilly, and other senior officers, have bought a total of 80,000 K-III common shares on the open market.
Reilly bought 50,000 shares and other executives bought 30,000 shares at prices ranging between $9.50 and $9.75 per share in separate transactions, the company said.
K-III is a media company involved in specialized information, educational services and niche consumer and trade publications.
